acceptance: Development or validation partitions gain independently developed applications whose page states exercise file inputs, virtualized or windowed lists, pagination and bulk selection, pinned, licensed, annotated by a separate session and measured on the unmodified recognizer, so T04 and T05 are ranked and tested on evidence; held-out stays untouched.

positive.fixture: jQuery File Upload (2 states) and Tabulator (7 states) captured reproducibly (64/64 digests), annotated, measured; baseline on 41 development and validation states

negative.fixture: manifest family and pin rules, alias and mount path safety, annotation validation and cluster ranking unit tests

versions.schema: manifest gains aliases and mounts; seal gains revisions

security_and_source_permissions: Public permissively licensed sources only; no upload server runs, so no file leaves the machine; dossiers withhold password-like values; held-out annotations were not consulted for any decision and four of them were redone from frozen dossiers with the change recorded in the seal.
performance_memory_storage: Capture 0.6 to 3.5 s per state; fixtures/corpus/dossiers adds about 0.7 MB of text.
known_limitations: Virtualized or windowed lists still have no independent evidence: no captured state is annotated virtual_list, and G11 must report that as not demonstrated
The validation partition has one family and none for the new areas
w2ui was dropped (empty cells in the accessibility tree)
